Ukraine's wartime economy depends on exports it can no longer easily ship
and reconstruction it cannot yet finance. This hub gathers work on export
diversification away from Russia-exposed routes, agrifood market access to
the EU, export promotion policy, and the broader research programme run
through the Kyiv School of Economics Foreign Trade Research Center
(Trade+).

**Ukrainian exporters that diversified destination markets before 2022
were significantly more resilient through the first two years of the
full-scale invasion** — diversification acted as insurance the market
priced too cheaply beforehand.
